occurrences.anchor_line: It's been aching for almost a week.
occurrences.displayExample: It's been aching for almost a week.

words.note: 表示持续的隐痛或酸痛；原句 aching 用来说明已经疼了一段时间。

occurrences.anchor_line: Good. Any egg allergies, either of you?
occurrences.displayExample: Good. Any egg allergies, either of you?

words.note: 指过敏或过敏情况；egg allergies 是问是否对鸡蛋过敏。

occurrences.anchor_line: Chest pain goes before a sprained ankle, every time.
occurrences.displayExample: Chest pain goes before a sprained ankle, every time.

words.note: 指脚踝；原句 sprained ankle 表示扭伤的脚踝。

occurrences.anchor_line: If the attacks keep happening, I can send a referral to a neurologist.
occurrences.displayExample: If the attacks keep happening, I can send a referral to a neurologist.

words.note: 这里指疾病或症状的一次发作，而不是受到攻击。

occurrences.anchor_line: He's awake and drinking.
occurrences.displayExample: He's awake and drinking.

words.note: 表示醒着、清醒着；本句用于回答孩子当下的状态。

occurrences.anchor_line: I'll prescribe something to relieve it, and suggest keeping a regular sleep schedule and cutting back on caffeine.
occurrences.displayExample: I'll prescribe something to relieve it, and suggest keeping a regular sleep schedule and cutting back on caffeine.

words.note: 指咖啡因；cutting back on caffeine 表示减少咖啡因摄入。

occurrences.anchor_line: I have this burning sensation in my chest right here.
occurrences.displayExample: I have this burning sensation in my chest right here.

words.note: 指胸部或胸口；in my chest 用来定位不适出现的部位。

occurrences.anchor_line: Could a clinician review his symptoms today?
occurrences.displayExample: Could a clinician review his symptoms today?

words.note: 泛指负责临床诊疗的医护人员；本句是请求有人评估症状。

occurrences.anchor_line: Hi, um, my son has a fever of 39 degrees.
occurrences.displayExample: Hi, um, my son has a fever of 39 degrees.

words.note: 在这句中表示体温的度数；39 degrees 跟在 fever 后说明具体温度。

occurrences.titleZh: 听懂诊断：病毒感染怎么办
occurrences.anchor_line: Yes. Get medical help sooner if you have trouble breathing, chest pain, or signs of dehydration.
occurrences.displayExample: Yes. Get medical help sooner if you have trouble breathing, chest pain, or signs of dehydration.

words.note: 表示脱水；signs of dehydration 是描述脱水迹象的搭配。

occurrences.titleZh: 血糖偏高，医生说先观察
occurrences.anchor_line: Your blood sugar is a little high, but not in the diabetic range.
occurrences.displayExample: Your blood sugar is a little high, but not in the diabetic range.

words.note: 表示与糖尿病有关的；本句用来修饰血糖数值所处的范围。

occurrences.anchor_line: For occasional symptoms, an antacid may help, but follow the directions on the packet.
occurrences.displayExample: For occasional symptoms, an antacid may help, but follow the directions on the packet.

words.note: 这里指药品包装上的使用说明，不是问路时的方向。

occurrences.anchor_line: If the chest discomfort doesn't go away or gets worse, get urgent medical help.
occurrences.displayExample: If the chest discomfort doesn't go away or gets worse, get urgent medical help.

words.note: 表示不舒服或不适，语气比直接说 pain 更宽泛。

occurrences.titleZh: 带孩子去药房打流感疫苗
occurrences.anchor_line: In case you feel dizzy, or have a reaction.
occurrences.displayExample: In case you feel dizzy, or have a reaction.

words.note: 表示头晕的；feel dizzy 用来描述自己当下的感觉。

occurrences.anchor_line: It might make you drowsy, so avoid driving.
occurrences.displayExample: It might make you drowsy, so avoid driving.

words.note: 表示困倦、昏昏欲睡的；本句在说明服药后可能出现的感觉。

occurrences.anchor_line: Just this dull ache that won't go away.
occurrences.displayExample: Just this dull ache that won't go away.

words.note: 描述隐隐的、钝钝的疼；dull ache 是本句中的固定搭配。

occurrences.titleZh: 血糖偏高，医生说先观察
occurrences.anchor_line: What does that mean exactly?
occurrences.displayExample: What does that mean exactly?

words.note: What does that mean exactly? 用来追问一句话具体是什么意思。

occurrences.anchor_line: Got it. Did you fast for this test?
occurrences.displayExample: Got it. Did you fast for this test?

words.note: fast 表示禁食，fasting 表示禁食状态；本句在确认检查前是否空腹。

occurrences.titleZh: 带孩子去药房打流感疫苗
occurrences.anchor_line: No fever, no cold?
occurrences.displayExample: No fever, no cold?

words.note: 这是两个并列症状词：fever 指发烧，cold 在这里指感冒。

occurrences.anchor_line: Please roll up your sleeve and make a fist.
occurrences.displayExample: Please roll up your sleeve and make a fist.

words.note: 指握起来的拳头；make a fist 是抽血前常见的动作提示。

occurrences.titleZh: 听懂诊断：病毒感染怎么办
occurrences.anchor_line: Get some rest, drink plenty of fluids, and keep an eye on your symptoms.
occurrences.displayExample: Get some rest, drink plenty of fluids, and keep an eye on your symptoms.

words.note: 这里指可饮用的液体；drink plenty of fluids 用于说明多补充液体。

occurrences.anchor_line: Yeah, it's frustrating.
occurrences.displayExample: Yeah, it's frustrating.

words.note: 表示一件事让人烦躁或挫败；描述事情用 frustrating，描述人的感受常用 frustrated。

occurrences.anchor_line: Doctor, I've had a really bad headache for the past two days, mostly on the right side, throbbing.
occurrences.displayExample: Doctor, I've had a really bad headache for the past two days, mostly on the right side, throbbing.

words.note: 指头痛；a really bad headache 强调程度，后面常补位置或持续时间。

occurrences.anchor_line: It could be heartburn.
occurrences.displayExample: It could be heartburn.

words.note: 表示烧心、胃灼热的感觉；原句用 it could be 表达一种可能性。

occurrences.titleZh: 听懂诊断：病毒感染怎么办
occurrences.anchor_line: If it's been more than 10 days with no improvement, or you start feeling better and then get worse again, give us a call.
occurrences.displayExample: If it's been more than 10 days with no improvement, or you start feeling better and then get worse again, give us a call.

words.note: 表示情况好转；no improvement 指症状没有改善。

occurrences.titleZh: 听懂诊断：病毒感染怎么办
occurrences.anchor_line: Everything points to a viral infection.
occurrences.displayExample: Everything points to a viral infection.

words.note: 指感染；viral infection 是病毒感染这一表达。

occurrences.anchor_line: Is it more like pressure or tightness, any shortness of breath, sweating, or pain in your arm or jaw?
occurrences.displayExample: Is it more like pressure or tightness, any shortness of breath, sweating, or pain in your arm or jaw?

words.note: 指颌部、下颌；本句把它和手臂等部位并列定位疼痛。

occurrences.titleZh: 听懂诊断：病毒感染怎么办
occurrences.anchor_line: Your strep test was negative, and your lungs sound clear.
occurrences.displayExample: Your strep test was negative, and your lungs sound clear.

words.note: 指肺；lungs sound clear 是医护描述听诊结果的一种说法。

occurrences.anchor_line: Hmm, last weekend I helped a friend move a mattress.
occurrences.displayExample: Hmm, last weekend I helped a friend move a mattress.

words.note: 指床垫；move a mattress 在本句中说明最近做过的搬抬动作。

occurrences.titleZh: 血糖偏高，医生说先观察
occurrences.anchor_line: So I don't need medication?
occurrences.displayExample: So I don't need medication?

words.note: 泛指药物或药物治疗；need medication 用来询问是否需要用药。

occurrences.anchor_line: Those symptoms are pretty typical of a migraine.
occurrences.displayExample: Those symptoms are pretty typical of a migraine.

words.note: 指偏头痛；a migraine 表示一次偏头痛或这种头痛情况。

occurrences.anchor_line: Any nausea, or sensitivity to light?
occurrences.displayExample: Any nausea, or sensitivity to light?

words.note: 表示恶心、想吐的感觉；问诊中常与其他症状并列询问。

occurrences.titleZh: 听懂诊断：病毒感染怎么办
occurrences.anchor_line: Your strep test was negative, and your lungs sound clear.
occurrences.displayExample: Your strep test was negative, and your lungs sound clear.

words.note: 在检测语境中分别指阴性和阳性；原句 negative 描述这次检测结果。

occurrences.anchor_line: If the attacks keep happening, I can send a referral to a neurologist.
occurrences.displayExample: If the attacks keep happening, I can send a referral to a neurologist.

words.note: 指神经科医生；a referral to a neurologist 表示转诊到神经科。

occurrences.anchor_line: For occasional symptoms, an antacid may help, but follow the directions on the packet.
occurrences.displayExample: For occasional symptoms, an antacid may help, but follow the directions on the packet.

words.note: 表示偶尔出现的；occasional symptoms 指并非一直存在的症状。

occurrences.anchor_line: He's old enough to get it here at the pharmacy.
occurrences.displayExample: He's old enough to get it here at the pharmacy.

words.note: 指药房；at the pharmacy 表示在药房这个地点。

occurrences.anchor_line: I'll refer you for physio and try not to sit for more than an hour at a time.
occurrences.displayExample: I'll refer you for physio and try not to sit for more than an hour at a time.

words.note: 是 physiotherapy 的常见简称；本句用于谈转去做物理治疗。

occurrences.anchor_line: You can also check them online on our portal.
occurrences.displayExample: You can also check them online on our portal.

words.note: 这里指可登录查看资料的在线平台；our portal 是诊所的线上入口。

occurrences.anchor_line: Great. The doctor prescribed amoxicillin.
occurrences.displayExample: Great. The doctor prescribed amoxicillin.

words.note: 表示开具处方或开药；后面直接接开出的药名。

occurrences.anchor_line: Hi, I'm here to pick up a prescription for Aria.
occurrences.displayExample: Hi, I'm here to pick up a prescription for Aria.

words.note: 可以指处方，也可在取药时指按处方配好的药；pick up a prescription 就是来取药。

occurrences.anchor_line: I'll check, but I can't promise a spot.
occurrences.displayExample: I'll check, but I can't promise a spot.

words.note: 表示保证或承诺；can't promise a spot 表示无法保证一定有名额。

occurrences.titleZh: 血糖偏高，医生说先观察
occurrences.anchor_line: Your blood sugar is a little high, but not in the diabetic range.
occurrences.displayExample: Your blood sugar is a little high, but not in the diabetic range.

words.note: 指数值范围；in the…range 用来说明检测数值落在哪个区间。

occurrences.titleZh: 带孩子去药房打流感疫苗
occurrences.anchor_line: Any bad reaction to a vaccine before?
occurrences.displayExample: Any bad reaction to a vaccine before?

words.note: 本句指接种后出现的反应；bad reaction 强调不良反应。

occurrences.anchor_line: And if either of you has a fever that day, call us and we'll rebook.
occurrences.displayExample: And if either of you has a fever that day, call us and we'll rebook.

words.note: 表示重新安排预约；本句是把原来的预约换到其他时间。

occurrences.titleZh: 带孩子去药房打流感疫苗
occurrences.anchor_line: Here's your record for today.
occurrences.displayExample: Here's your record for today.

words.note: 这里指接种记录；your record for today 是本次接种的记录。

occurrences.anchor_line: I'll refer you for physio and try not to sit for more than an hour at a time.
occurrences.displayExample: I'll refer you for physio and try not to sit for more than an hour at a time.

words.note: 医疗语境中指转诊；refer you for physio 表示转去接受物理治疗。

occurrences.anchor_line: You can relax your fist now.
occurrences.displayExample: You can relax your fist now.

words.note: 本句 relax your fist 表示松开握着的拳头，不是让人去休息。

occurrences.anchor_line: Thank you. When and how can I get the results?
occurrences.displayExample: Thank you. When and how can I get the results?

words.note: 指检查或检测结果；get the results 是询问何时拿到结果的说法。

occurrences.anchor_line: I have this burning sensation in my chest right here.
occurrences.displayExample: I have this burning sensation in my chest right here.

words.note: 表示身体感受到的感觉；a burning sensation 描述灼烧感。

occurrences.anchor_line: The doctor will call you shortly.
occurrences.displayExample: The doctor will call you shortly.

words.note: 表示不久、一会儿；will call you shortly 用来说明很快会联系或叫到你。

occurrences.anchor_line: Do you have any urgent slots or after hours appointments?
occurrences.displayExample: Do you have any urgent slots or after hours appointments?

words.note: slot 常指可预约时段，spot 可指空出的名额；本句在询问紧急预约是否有空位。

occurrences.anchor_line: Chest pain goes before a sprained ankle, every time.
occurrences.displayExample: Chest pain goes before a sprained ankle, every time.

words.note: 表示扭伤；原句 sprained 修饰 ankle，说明脚踝已经扭伤。

occurrences.anchor_line: Have you been under a lot of stress lately?
occurrences.displayExample: Have you been under a lot of stress lately?

words.note: stress 是压力，stressful 形容事情让人有压力；本句用 a lot of stress 描述近期状态。

occurrences.anchor_line: Is it more like pressure or tightness, any shortness of breath, sweating, or pain in your arm or jaw?
occurrences.displayExample: Is it more like pressure or tightness, any shortness of breath, sweating, or pain in your arm or jaw?

words.note: 表示出汗；本句把它列在其他身体症状之间询问。

occurrences.anchor_line: It feels like the burning is coming up my throat.
occurrences.displayExample: It feels like the burning is coming up my throat.

words.note: 指喉咙；up my throat 描述灼烧感向喉咙上移的感觉。

occurrences.anchor_line: Is it more like pressure or tightness, any shortness of breath, sweating, or pain in your arm or jaw?
occurrences.displayExample: Is it more like pressure or tightness, any shortness of breath, sweating, or pain in your arm or jaw?

words.note: 表示发紧、紧绷感；问诊里常与 pressure 并列描述胸口感觉。

occurrences.titleZh: 血糖偏高，医生说先观察
occurrences.anchor_line: It means we don't need to treat it right now, but we do want to keep an eye on it.
occurrences.displayExample: It means we don't need to treat it right now, but we do want to keep an eye on it.

words.note: 表示进行治疗；treat it 指对前面提到的情况采取治疗。

occurrences.anchor_line: But they do triage here — it's not first come, first served.
occurrences.displayExample: But they do triage here — it's not first come, first served.

words.note: 指分诊；原句用它解释为什么并非按先到先看的顺序安排。

occurrences.anchor_line: He has school on weekdays, and I work.
occurrences.displayExample: He has school on weekdays, and I work.

words.note: 指周一至周五这样的工作日；on weekdays 表示在工作日。
